# Context Crystal: Machine-Readable Guide for AI Entities (llms.txt)

> **Context Crystal** is a sovereign, deterministic, local-first context and DAG lifecycle engine.
> Sub-5ms native binary (Scala Native + Immix GC). 0 LLM tokens consumed for context management.
> Standard: JSON Schema v1 (`spec/v1/context-crystal.json`) with JSON-LD semantics.

## Core Philosophy for AI Agents
- **Never rely on chat memory:** Treat chat windows as ephemeral. Check crystals at turn inception (`ccrystal list` or `crystal_list`).
- **Context Beam Hydration:** Cast living context before making multi-step edits (`ccrystal hydrate <id> --tail 5` or `crystal_hydrate`).
- **Zero Agent Debris:** Register an explicit transient lease for every temporary git worktree or mock config (`ccrystal transient lease` or `crystal_transient_lease`). Clean or promote leases before marking goals concluded.
- **Atomic Multi-Command Batching:** Compose atomic update recipes separated by semicolons (`ccrystal batch "cmd1; cmd2"` or `crystal_batch`).

## Installation
Single-line curl installer:
```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oswaldo/context-crystal/main/install.sh | sh
```

## Essential CLI Subcommands
```bash
# Initialize crystal with atomic tasks
ccrystal init <id> -g "<goal-title>" -i "<intent>" -t "<task-1>" -t "<task-2>"

# List cave crystals
ccrystal list [--status in_progress|concluded] [--json]

# Hydrate context beam
ccrystal hydrate <id> [--tail <N>] [--from <sel>] [--to <sel>] [--summary-only]

# Transition task
ccrystal task done <id> -t <task-id>
ccrystal task add <id> -d "<description>"

# Append causal DAG node
ccrystal node add <id> -k <checkpoint|prompt|action|resolution> -s "<summary>" --fidelity inferred

# Manage transient resource leases
ccrystal transient lease <id> -t <git_worktree|mock_service> -p <path> -d "<desc>" --policy revert_on_conclusion
ccrystal transient clean <id> -l <lease-id>

# Slice and fork sub-DAG
ccrystal slice <id> --from <anchor> --fork-to <child-id> [--prune]

# Start native Model Context Protocol (MCP) server
ccrystal mcp
```

## Native MCP Server Tools (stdio JSON-RPC 2.0)
1. `crystal_init`: Instantiate crystal with goal, intent, and optional `tasks: string[]`.
2. `crystal_list`: Query cave crystals with optional status filter.
3. `crystal_hydrate`: Beam shaping with `tail`, `from`, `to`, `depth`, `summary_only`.
4. `crystal_triage`: Automated cave hygiene (`CandidateForCleanup`, `Keep`, `RequiresReview`).
5. `crystal_artifact`: Register, list, or inspect virtual and physical artifacts.
6. `crystal_checkpoint`: Append immutable DAG checkpoint node.
7. `crystal_task_transition`: Complete or update acceptance criteria.
8. `crystal_transient_lease`: Acquire temporary resource lease.
9. `crystal_slice_fork`: Cleave sub-DAG into child crystal.
10. `crystal_delete`: Delete crystal with cascade entity preview.
11. `crystal_batch`: Execute semicolon-delimited CLI recipes atomically.
